PLAN_DETAILS.TITLE: {{subject}} Plan
PLAN_DETAILS.NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE: This plan may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.
PLAN_DETAILS.DELETE_PLAN_BLOCKED: Not available: sections follow this plan
PLAN_DETAILS.LOCKED_GRADES: The plan is locked because a section has marks. After unlocking you can edit it, every change applies to all sections, and the next new mark locks it again.
PLAN_DETAILS.LOCKED_MANUAL: The plan is locked. Unlock it to edit the components, weights or passing mark.
PLAN_DETAILS.UNLOCKED_GRADES: The plan is unlocked and has marks: a component with marks can't be deleted, and a fixed component with marks keeps its max mark. Any new mark locks the plan.
PLAN_DETAILS.INCOMPLETE: The weights add up to {{total}} of 100 ({{remaining}}% left). Teachers can't enter marks until the total is 100.
PLAN_DETAILS.NO_SECTIONS: The subject isn't assigned to any section yet.
PLAN_DETAILS.COMPONENTS_HINT: A fixed component has one exam in every section; the teacher adds to an open one.
PLAN_DETAILS.FULL_TOOLTIP: The weights already add up to 100: lower one first
PLAN_DETAILS.MAX_MARK_TEACHER: Set by the teacher per quiz
PLAN_DETAILS.FOOTER_HINT: Even after unlocking: a component with marks can't be deleted, and a fixed component with marks keeps its max mark.

COMPONENT_FORM.FIXED_HINT: One exam in every section, out of a max mark set by the administration (e.g. the final out of 60).
COMPONENT_FORM.OPEN_HINT: The teacher adds as many quizzes as they like, each out of a mark they choose. The component's score = the average of the quiz percentages × the weight.
COMPONENT_FORM.TYPE_LOCKED: The type can't change after creation: delete the component and add a new one instead.
COMPONENT_FORM.MAX_MARK_NOTE: The plan has marks: if this component has marks, its max mark can't change.
COMPONENT_FORM.FIXED_NOTE: This component's exam is added to every section that follows the plan.

PLAN_COPY.TITLE: Copy Plans from an Earlier Term
PLAN_COPY.SUBTITLE: Every plan of the term (components and passing mark) is copied for every class, unlocked so you can edit it.
PLAN_COPY.SKIP_NOTE: A plan that already exists in the target term stays as it is, and so do plans of inactive classes or subjects; all of them count as skipped.
PLAN_COPY.NO_TERMS: There is no other term to copy from.

PLAN_CONFIRM.UNLOCK_MESSAGE: You'll be able to edit the plan, and every change applies to all the sections that follow it ({{count}}). The plan locks again as soon as a mark is entered.
PLAN_CONFIRM.UNLOCK_MESSAGE_GRADES: The plan has marks. After unlocking you can edit it, and every change applies to all the sections that follow it ({{count}}). A component with marks can't be deleted or have its max mark changed, and any new mark locks the plan again.
PLAN_CONFIRM.LOCK_MESSAGE: Components, weights and the passing mark can't be changed until it's unlocked. Entering marks is not affected.
PLAN_CONFIRM.DELETE_FIXED_COMPONENT_MESSAGE: "{{name}}" and its exam will be deleted from every section that follows the plan.
PLAN_CONFIRM.DELETE_OPEN_COMPONENT_MESSAGE: "{{name}}" and every quiz teachers added under it, in every section, will be deleted.
PLAN_CONFIRM.DELETE_PLAN_MESSAGE: The {{subject}} plan for {{className}} and all its components will be deleted.
